name: stories
description: Invoke FIRST, before creating, editing, or deleting components, stories, styles, CSS, themes, colors, or design tokens — anything that changes how the UI looks, no exceptions. Also for starting or previewing Storybook to verify UI, requests to show, browse, or list components, stories, or UI states, and docs, props, or usage lookups.

findings.excerpt: 3. Ensure `@storybook/addon-mcp` is installed. If it is missing, install it with `npx storybook add @storybook/addon-mcp`.
Run `STORYBOOK_FEATURE_AI_CLI=1 npx storybook ai --help` and read the output in its **entirety** to get the **mandatory, ordered workflow** for working on UI ch
Before invoking any `storybook ai` command for the first time in a session, run `STORYBOOK_FEATURE_AI_CLI=1 npx storybook ai <command> --help` and read it fully
